input.document: The library team released version 2.4 on Monday. It adds encrypted backups and reduces startup time by 20 percent. Users must run the migration before upgrading production.

summary: The release adds encrypted backups and reduces startup time by 20 percent.
A migration is required before upgrading production.

input.document: The incident began at 14:05 UTC when the payment queue stopped processing. Engineers restored service at 14:32 UTC and identified an expired certificate as the cause. The team will add certificate-expiry alerting.

summary: Payment queue processing stopped at 14:05 UTC.
Service was restored at 14:32 UTC after an expired certificate was identified.
The follow-up action is certificate-expiry alerting.

input.document: The research group will pilot the document search assistant with 20 analysts during April. The pilot measures answer groundedness, latency, and user corrections. No customer data is included in the pilot dataset.

summary: The document search assistant will be piloted with 20 analysts during April.
The pilot measures groundedness, latency, and user corrections.
The pilot dataset excludes customer data.
